queries.name: routing-session-observations
queries.subject: Read metadata-only unified-session routing evidence.
queries.objective: Keep routing analytics independent of native logs and inferred run totals.
queries.acceptance: Only recognized session events contribute; event clocks remain absent when unrecorded.

queries.name: routing-session-attempts
queries.subject: Identify available session files and their earliest recorded clocks.
queries.objective: Keep rerun attempts from multiplying routing denominators.
queries.acceptance: Attempt order is only a tie-breaker after the recorded session clock.

queries.name: routing-session-order
queries.subject: Order duplicate run sessions by run time and attempt.
queries.objective: Keep the latest file for each repository/run identity.
queries.acceptance: Only one attempt contributes to routing facts.

queries.name: routing-latest-sessions
queries.subject: Retain one authoritative session attempt per run.
queries.objective: Avoid mixing picks or accounting from reruns.
queries.acceptance: Duplicate attempts remain available in session coverage.

queries.name: routing-session-events
queries.subject: Read routing metadata from the latest session file per run.
queries.objective: Deduplicate rerun attempts before any metric.
queries.acceptance: Earlier attempts never add cost or change the selected pick.

queries.name: routing-run-facts
queries.subject: Collect per-session source facts without interpreting absence as success.
queries.objective: Resolve routing states and coverage from runner and proxy evidence.
queries.acceptance: Agent-phase proxy selection wins over failure and harness status; untimed observations keep unknown time.

queries.name: routing-ordered-selections
queries.subject: Order proxy selections within each session.
queries.objective: Use the last selection by normalized clock and file order.
queries.acceptance: Harness and advisory picks never override proxy selections.

queries.name: routing-selections
queries.subject: Retain one authoritative proxy pick per run.
queries.objective: Avoid multiplying requests or run counts after re-selection.
queries.acceptance: One row per identified run uses the final proxy selection.

queries.name: routing-resolved-runs
queries.subject: Resolve routing state, pick and label cells from unified sessions.
queries.objective: Distinguish selected, failed, harness-only, configured, inferred and unknown evidence.
queries.acceptance: Proxy evidence wins; configuration conflicts are visible; missing picks and time remain unknown.

queries.name: routing-filter-candidates
queries.subject: Apply one run-level scope before every routing metric and event join.
queries.objective: Filter complete sessions, never fragments of their evidence.
queries.acceptance: Unknown run time is excluded from a bounded range; blank filters retain all known values.

queries.name: routing-runs
queries.subject: Retain identified runs matching every selected routing filter.
queries.objective: Use the same population for adoption, accounting and outcomes.
queries.acceptance: A time bound excludes untimed runs and does not remove individual events from retained sessions.

queries.name: routing-events
queries.subject: Retain all evidence belonging to scoped identified runs.
queries.objective: Filter event metrics by the resolved run rather than by individual event clocks.
queries.acceptance: State, pick and accounting are computed before the scope is applied.

queries.name: routing-phase-sources
queries.subject: Choose one nonoverlapping accounting source per run and phase.
queries.objective: Prefer proxy token usage over usage reports.
queries.acceptance: Snapshot totals and cumulative totalAic never enter additive cost.

queries.name: routing-accounting-candidates
queries.subject: Read nonoverlapping per-response accounting records.
queries.objective: Expose recorded credits and token classes without repricing unknown usage.
queries.acceptance: Each phase uses proxy accounting when present and usage.report otherwise; absent AIC is counted.

queries.name: routing-accounting
queries.subject: Select the authoritative accounting source for each phase.
queries.objective: Exclude overlapping usage reports and snapshots.
queries.acceptance: Every accounting row contributes at most once.

queries.name: routing-request-candidates
queries.subject: Keep per-request routing decisions separate from accounting.
queries.objective: Join routed outcomes by run, phase and request ID.
queries.acceptance: Rejected requests establish local zero cost; other unmatched requests retain unknown cost.

queries.name: routing-request-records
queries.subject: Retain the latest record for each request identity.
queries.objective: Avoid duplicate request joins and overlapping totals.
queries.acceptance: Requests without IDs remain independent, not falsely correlated.

queries.name: routing-subagent-candidates
queries.subject: Read engine-reported sub-agent request ownership.
queries.objective: Use exact request-ID ownership before falling back to unsplit traffic.
queries.acceptance: Only request identities can assign exact ownership; advisory outcomes never assign credits.

queries.name: routing-subagent-requests
queries.subject: Retain one sub-agent observation per request identity.
queries.objective: Keep exact ownership joins unique.
queries.acceptance: Missing identities do not match unrelated requests.

queries.name: routing-exact-accounting
queries.subject: Attribute each accounting record to exactly one traffic bucket.
queries.objective: Keep detection, evals, classifier, exact sub-agent, main, unsplit and unattributed credits distinct.
queries.acceptance: Detection and evals use phase, missing purpose is never agent by default, and snapshot credits are excluded.

queries.name: routing-correlation-usage-candidates
queries.subject: Find accounting records without exact sub-agent ownership.
queries.objective: Correlate only fully recorded token quartets in file order.
queries.acceptance: Missing token classes never match by model alone.

queries.name: routing-correlation-usage
queries.subject: Order unmatched accounting within model and token quartet.
queries.objective: Match each engine-reported request at most once.
queries.acceptance: Classifier, incomplete and already-exact requests are excluded.

queries.name: routing-correlation-subagent-candidates
queries.subject: Exclude engine requests already matched by proxy request ID.
queries.objective: Prevent exact and correlated ownership from claiming the same request.
queries.acceptance: Only engine requests with a complete quartet and a definition name can correlate.

queries.name: routing-correlation-subagents
queries.subject: Order unmatched engine requests within each model/token quartet.
queries.objective: Produce deterministic one-to-one correlated ownership.
queries.acceptance: Correlation is labelled separately from exact evidence.

queries.name: routing-correlated-accounting
queries.subject: Join proxy usage with unmatched engine requests by model, quartet and occurrence.
queries.objective: Use the spec's correlated sub-agent attribution without duplicating credits.
queries.acceptance: Each engine request and accounting record participates at most once.

queries.name: routing-attributed-accounting
queries.subject: Assign every accounting record to exactly one exclusive bucket.
queries.objective: Keep exact and correlated sub-agent ownership distinct.
queries.acceptance: Phase wins over purpose; missing ownership remains unsplit or unattributed.

queries.name: routing-joined-requests
queries.subject: Inspect per-request deviations and outcomes against proxy picks.
queries.objective: Keep requests without accounting visible and never invent a deviation cause.
queries.acceptance: Unmatched requests have unknown cost; each request retains its own requested and selected model.

queries.name: routing-unaccounted-failures
queries.subject: Count failed requests lacking accounting per run.
queries.objective: Recognize only unambiguous AWF-local effort failures.
queries.acceptance: A run-level effort failure cannot assign zero to multiple failed requests.

queries.name: routing-deviations
queries.subject: Resolve explicit local zero costs and preserve all other unknown request costs.
queries.objective: Avoid partial-cost comparisons based on missing accounting.
queries.acceptance: Only guard rejection or an unambiguous local effort failure establishes zero AIC.

queries.name: routing-phase-usage
queries.subject: Sum nonoverlapping accounting per run and phase.
queries.objective: Establish complete costs only with known response values.
queries.acceptance: Unknown response costs remain counted.

queries.name: routing-request-coverage
queries.subject: Count requests whose cost remains unknown.
queries.objective: Exclude incomplete runs from distribution comparisons.
queries.acceptance: Unmatched nonlocal requests cannot be treated as free.

queries.name: routing-phase-costs
queries.subject: Evaluate accounting completeness using collected source receipts and request joins.
queries.objective: Exclude partial costs from medians and comparisons.
queries.acceptance: A complete phase has its selected accounting source, no missing AIC and no unaccounted nonlocal requests.

queries.name: routing-agent-costs
queries.subject: Select complete or explicitly partial agent-phase costs.
queries.objective: Keep detection and evals out of agent-phase comparisons.
queries.acceptance: Classifier remains part of agent-phase cost.

queries.name: routing-detection-costs
queries.subject: Retain detection-phase cost completeness separately.
queries.objective: Do not count detection as classifier or agent traffic.
queries.acceptance: Missing detection evidence remains unknown, not zero.

queries.name: routing-cost-runs
queries.subject: Attach accounting completeness to identified routing runs.
queries.objective: Provide comparable costs only for complete runs.
queries.acceptance: An absent cost stays unknown and never inherits aggregate run AIC.

queries.name: routing-run-summary
queries.subject: Keep the selected Run's compact routing and baseline evidence visible.
queries.objective: Preserve the comparison when shorter-lived Audit detail expires.
queries.acceptance: Retained aggregate costs and baseline evidence survive Audit expiry; absent phase details stay unknown.

queries.name: routing-weekly-cost-totals
queries.subject: Summarize complete agent-phase costs by UTC ISO week and routing state.
queries.objective: Expose trends without including partial costs.
queries.acceptance: Untimed runs cannot enter time buckets.

queries.name: routing-weekly-accounting-cost
queries.subject: Gate weekly medians by complete sample size.
queries.objective: Keep sparse weeks from implying meaningful cost trends.
queries.acceptance: Weeks below the configurable minimum display insufficient data.

queries.name: routing-resolutions
queries.subject: Read runner-written configured-model resolutions for scoped routing runs.
queries.objective: Explain what each workflow role's configured model resolved to before the engine launched.
queries.acceptance: Only model.resolution facts from latest scoped attempts contribute; missing or unsafe values and failed null resolutions remain unknown.

queries.name: routing-health-totals
queries.subject: Count routed runs and their selection, failure, adherence, outcome and cost evidence per repository and workflow.
queries.objective: Answer whether routing is on and working from one row per routed workflow.
queries.acceptance: Only selected, selection_failed, harness_reported and configured_unrecorded runs contribute; runs without evidence stay out of each denominator.

queries.name: routing-health
queries.subject: Show routing health shares per repository and workflow.
queries.objective: Tell whether routing is on and working from selection, failure or fallback, pick adherence, known outcomes and complete cost.
queries.acceptance: A zero denominator or no complete cost is unknown, never zero; unknown job outcomes are excluded from the success rate.

queries.name: routing-weekly-models
queries.subject: Count proxy-selected runs by UTC ISO week and picked model.
queries.objective: Show what the router chooses over time.
queries.acceptance: Only selected runs with a known pick model and a recorded run clock contribute; an unrecorded effort does not exclude a run.

queries.name: routing-weekly-paired-totals
queries.subject: Weekly paired complete main-request costs by baseline model.
queries.objective: Compare routing cost trends with each named baseline using identical main-request populations.
queries.acceptance: Only timed runs with complete positive baseline estimates and matching known main-request costs contribute to both medians.

queries.name: routing-weekly-paired-cost
queries.subject: Paired main-request samples that meet the chosen evidence floor.
queries.objective: Avoid changing routing policy based on insufficient paired evidence.
queries.acceptance: Observed and estimated series share the same complete-run count and configurable minimum sample.

queries.name: routing-weekly-main-observed
queries.subject: Observed main-request AIC for the same eligible runs as each baseline.
queries.objective: Identify weeks when routed main-request costs exceed the matching baseline estimate.
queries.acceptance: Observed medians exclude classifier and sub-agent costs and remain unknown below the paired sample floor.

queries.name: routing-weekly-baseline-estimate
queries.subject: Explicitly estimated baseline AIC for paired main-agent requests.
queries.objective: Show the named counterfactual against which owners can assess routing goal or mode.
queries.acceptance: The series is labelled estimated, separates baseline models and uses exactly the observed series' eligible runs.

queries.name: routing-weekly-cost
queries.subject: Compare the same main-agent requests to an explicitly estimated baseline.
queries.objective: Change routing goal or mode when paired observed cost exceeds the named baseline.
queries.acceptance: Keep agent-phase accounting separate, baseline models distinct and sparse weeks as gaps.

queries.name: routing-failure-problems
queries.subject: Runs whose routing failure codes require investigation.
queries.objective: Investigate routing configuration or execution failures before changing rollout.
queries.acceptance: Emit one row per run with recorded routing failure identifiers, excluding upstream errors handled by their own kind.

queries.name: routing-deviation-problems
queries.subject: Runs whose requests deviated from the routing pick.
queries.objective: Investigate why requests did not follow the selected model or effort.
queries.acceptance: Emit one row per run with distinct recorded deviation causes, without inferring causes from model names.

queries.name: routing-resolution-problems
queries.subject: Runs whose configured models could not be resolved.
queries.objective: Correct model aliases or restore catalogue availability for failed resolutions.
queries.acceptance: Emit one row per run with recorded resolution failure causes, not absence of resolution evidence.

queries.name: routing-upstream-problems
queries.subject: Provider-rejected requests with distinct upstream error codes.
queries.objective: Correct model or effort settings rejected by the provider.
queries.acceptance: Emit one upstream-error row per run with distinct safe codes or unknown, never a duplicate generic routing failure.

queries.name: routing-candidate-problems
queries.subject: Runs whose full eligible pool contains choices the router cannot rank.
queries.objective: Review allowed models when the router cannot rank the complete eligible pool.
queries.acceptance: Emit one row only when both pool counters are known and overlap is below eligibility, displaying the observed ratio.

queries.name: routing-problems
queries.subject: List routing failures, deviations and resolution failures with one row per run and kind.
queries.objective: Show what needs attention and link each problem to its run page.
queries.acceptance: Time is the run's recorded observation time and stays unknown without a run clock; untimed rows sort after timed rows.

pages.title: Model routing
pages.intent: Investigate routing choices from unified sessions.
pages.subject: Runner and proxy metadata from usage/aw_session.jsonl.
pages.objective: Identify choices and evidence gaps requiring investigation.
pages.acceptance: Proxy evidence wins; unknown costs and observational comparisons remain explicit.
pages.description: Inspect routing health, picked models, cost per run and problems from unified-session metadata.

form.title: Routing scope
form.description: Exact values; leave blank for all. Time bounds are UTC RFC 3339, inclusive start and exclusive end. Coverage includes excluded sessions.

views.title: Routing health by workflow
views.subject: Routed runs per repository and workflow.
views.objective: Decide whether routing should stay enabled or its goal or mode should change.
views.acceptance: Compare sums for the same complete main-request population against each named baseline; absent or incomplete estimates stay unknown.
views.description: Estimated cost vs baseline is observed main-request AIC divided by the named baseline estimate for the same eligible runs, not causal savings. Only complete estimates with positive denominators and matching known main-request costs contribute. Classifier, sub-agent, detection and eval costs are excluded from that comparison, but remain in accounting. Other health shares retain their evidence-specific denominators. Unknown is not zero.

views.title: Models picked over time
views.subject: Proxy-selected runs by UTC ISO week and picked model.
views.objective: Adjust allowed models when the observed selection mix is inappropriate.
views.acceptance: Decide from one aggregate per run with a known proxy pick and recorded clock, not from request counts.
views.description: Proxy selections only; harness-reported, configured-unrecorded and unrouted runs are not counted.
views.empty-message: No timed proxy selections were recorded.

views.title: Cost per run over time
views.subject: Weekly accounting and paired observed main-request AIC versus the named estimated baseline.
views.objective: Decide whether to keep routing without mistaking estimates for causal savings.
views.acceptance: Each baseline series uses the same complete runs as its observed series; weeks below the sample floor are gaps.
views.description: Baseline estimate is an estimated counterfactual for the same main-agent requests, not causal savings. Observed main-request and baseline series use the same eligible runs and name the baseline model. Agent-phase accounting remains separate. Routed versus unrouted accounting is observational: these are different tasks. Sparse weeks are gaps, never zero.
views.empty-message: No timed complete-cost samples are available.

views.title: Problems
views.subject: Routing failures, deviations, resolution failures, upstream errors and candidate coverage per run.
views.objective: Choose which model or effort setting and allowed-model policy needs correction.
views.acceptance: One row per run and kind; missing counters never diagnose unrankable candidates, and upstream events are not duplicated as generic failures.
views.description: One row per run and kind of problem. Open a row for the run's routing detail. Time is unknown when the run has no recorded clock.
views.empty-message: No routing failures, deviations or resolution failures were recorded; missing evidence does not establish success.

views.title: Routing runs
views.subject: One compact routing aggregate per identified run.
views.objective: Open the run detail and usage artifact before changing a workflow's routing policy.
views.acceptance: One row per run preserves its pick, scope and drill-down link without counting requests as runs.
views.description: Open a run for its routing timeline and collection coverage. Harness status is reported, not authoritative. Re-selection counts include the final selection.
views.empty-message: No identified routing sessions are available.

pages.title: Model routing run
pages.intent: Inspect one run's authoritative routing timeline and coverage.
pages.subject: Unified-session model routing facts for one run.
pages.objective: Trace proxy decisions and missing accounting without exposing content.
pages.acceptance: Scope complete run partitions before session selection and accounting joins; preserve every attempt until latest-session selection. Untimed facts have no invented timestamp and agent-written outcomes remain advisory.
pages.description: Trace one run's proxy decisions, advisory reports, accounting and collection coverage.

views.title: Agent-phase accounting coverage
views.subject: The selected run's compact routing aggregate and accounting coverage.
views.objective: Compare known main-request cost to the named baseline before acting.
views.acceptance: Incomplete baseline estimates stay explicitly incomplete; deeper evidence is available from the Actions run's usage artifact.
views.description: The aggregate preserves the main-request baseline comparison separately from total accounting. Open the Actions run and download its usage artifact for the full aw_session.jsonl. Per-request and attribution evidence below is retained to explain unmatched costs without treating them as zero.
views.empty-message: This session has no retained verified workflow identity.

views.subject: Selected-run request deviations and explicitly known request costs.
views.objective: Explain unknown costs and deviations before adjusting routing policy.
views.acceptance: Run-scoped request rows explain aggregate coverage; absent AIC is never treated as free.
views.empty-message: No per-request routing evidence was retained.

views.subject: Selected-run accounting split into exclusive traffic buckets.
views.objective: Exclude classifier, sub-agent, detection and eval traffic from main-request decisions.
views.acceptance: Run-scoped attribution retains unknown ownership rather than inventing main-agent cost.
views.empty-message: No per-response accounting evidence was retained.

views.subject: Identifier-only selected-run routing evidence and upstream error codes.
views.objective: Inspect the failing request or download the full usage artifact for deeper analysis.
views.acceptance: No provider bodies or messages are shown; unknown error identifiers remain unknown.
views.empty-message: No retained routing evidence is available for this run.

views.subject: Selected-run configured-to-resolved model identities.
views.objective: Identify which workflow role needs a model configuration change.
views.acceptance: Missing role or resolution evidence never implies a successful resolution.
views.description: Runner-written configured-model resolution for each role before engine launch. Resolution records carry no timestamp of their own.
views.empty-message: No configured-model resolution was recorded for this run. Routed or older sessions may not record it; absence is not a failure.
